description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named TaxClassController for managing tax classes within an e-commerce admin interface. It provides endpoints to list, create, update, delete, and edit tax classes, integrating with service layers and managing request/response interactions.

classes.name: TaxClassController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling CRUD operations for TaxClass entities within the admin panel, secured with role-based access control.

methods.name: displayTaxClasses
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the list of tax classes for the current store.

methods.name: pageTaxClasses
methods.description: Handles POST request to fetch and return paged tax class data in JSON format.

methods.name: saveTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new tax class, with validation for duplicate codes.

methods.name: updateTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing tax class, ensuring code uniqueness.

methods.name: removeTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST request to remove a tax class, with checks to prevent deletion if associated products exist.

methods.name: editTaxClass
methods.description: Handles GET request to load a tax class for editing based on ID.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set menu context attributes for the view.
